en: The ninetieth counter is purple in the last of nine groups of ten.
ja: 十個ずつ九つに分けて並べた玉のうち、九十番目だけが紫色になっている。
prompt:
Subject ninetieth 第90の. A single square educational counting board divided into NINE panels arranged three columns by three rows. EACH panel contains TEN round cream counters arranged two rows of five. Nine separate ten-frames = 90 counters total. Only the last counter of the bottom-right panel is purple, indicating the ninetieth. Eight panels contain 10 cream counters, bottom-right panel contains 9 cream and 1 purple. Each panel has a smooth light blue fill and dark brown border. Absolutely no people, hands or text. All nine frames clearly visible, complete, no overlap. Compact simple flat front view.
Use attached invidious.png for drawing style only: thick rounded dark brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D forms. Exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands per person, normal compact forearm proportions. Clean smooth solid colors and restrained flat shadows. No watercolor grain, muddiness, speckles, mottling, paper texture, bleed or fuzzy edges. Transparent background, no detached ground shadows. All silhouettes clean closed dark brown outlines. 512x512 PNG RGBA. No text.
